title: An empty Unassigned group stays visible to drop work into
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Unassigned has no work; Assigned to me is off; in Tech View.
custom_steps:
1. Ensure Unassigned has no work and Assigned to me is off.
  2. Switch to Tech View.
  3. Confirm the Unassigned group is still present with its empty state.
  4. Confirm a work order can be dropped onto it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When Unassigned has no work and "Assigned to me" is off, the Unassigned group stays present with its empty state and can still receive dropped work.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10045 — Tech View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S2-N1 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-N1: “When Unassigned has no work, the group stays on screen with its empty state as a drop target, except while Assigned to me is enabled (S2-R9), and following S1-N1 when no work orders match the filters.”
